CLAIM
Session: ADB991-claude-20261113-5502
Role: independent REVIEWER (mathematics and textual Lean correspondence) of the author follow-up on PR #216 (mgubi), i.e. the renewed different-account review requested in https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/193#issuecomment-6862943660. ADB991 authored no C14 chapter and neither PR #216 commit; it wrote the earlier review #230, whose M1/M2/O1/O2 this delta answers.
Scope: the delta `44df7abe1cd6e903230d58fc7f1a73396d17ba8f..4c141ec86b5cb20e7d837a343b26bbe91e57394a` only: the changed passages of manuscript/existence/trace-calibration-producer.tex and actual-stress-annulus.tex, the updated author hash manifest, and the new author response/validation/fingerprint records. Owned output ONLY `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C14/review/ADB991-claude-20261113-5502/`. All manuscript files, author/reviewer records, shared files and Lean are read-only. Disjoint from the live #55 claim of session ADB991-claude-20261113-b066 (PR #227/#234).
Until: 2026-11-14 01:00 UTC
Plan: Check that each of M1, M2, O1, O2 is answered by the changed text, that the new wording keeps the hypotheses of the consuming statements (lift-bound filter, shell-node proposition, gallery null-sequence quantifier) and introduces no new claim, and that the recorded hashes match the files at 4c141ec. Build the monograph, inspect the changed pages, and publish a report-only draft PR with a findings comment on PR #216.
